    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C# 实现优雅的热重载：基于 PicoServer 的 Live Reload 方案</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2807317/202606/2807317-20260609112755624-1604598221.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>.NET 是一个开源、跨平台的开发平台，运行稳定，资源消耗低，AOT 编译进一步降低了交付体积。本文基于 .NET 10 实现一个零配置的热重载服务器，核心代码不到 50 行。</p>
<p>依赖安装：<code>dotnet add package PicoServer</code><br>
NuGet：<a href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/PicoServer" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.nuget.org/packages/PicoServer</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="一热重载的本质">一、热重载的本质</h2>
<p>热重载解决的问题：<strong>文件保存后浏览器自动刷新</strong>。</p>
<p>传统流程：修改 → 保存 → 切换窗口 → F5（4 步）<br>
热重载后：修改 → 保存（2 步）</p>
<p>核心流程：</p>
<pre><code>文件变更 → 服务端检测 → WebSocket 推送 → 浏览器刷新
</code></pre>
<h2 id="二实现">二、实现</h2>
<h3 id="21-文件监控与防抖">2.1 文件监控与防抖</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using PicoServer;
using System.Timers;
using System.IO;

string staticRoot = "wwwroot";
var app = new WebAPIServer();

var watcher = new FileSystemWatcher(staticRoot)
{
    EnableRaisingEvents = true,
    IncludeSubdirectories = true
};

var timer = new System.Timers.Timer(200) { AutoReset = false };
timer.Elapsed += async (_, _) =&gt; await app.WsBroadcastAsync("reload");

void OnChange(object s, FileSystemEventArgs e)
{
    var name = Path.GetFileName(e.Name);
    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) || name.StartsWith('.') || name.StartsWith('~'))
        return;  // 过滤 IDE 临时文件
    
    timer.Stop();
    timer.Start();  // 200ms 内无新事件才触发
}

watcher.Changed += OnChange;
watcher.Created += OnChange;
watcher.Deleted += OnChange;
watcher.Renamed += OnChange;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>防抖的必要性</strong>：一次保存操作可能触发 Changed、Created、Renamed 多个事件，防抖将其合并为一次广播，避免页面重复刷新。</p>
<h3 id="22-websocket-广播">2.2 WebSocket 广播</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">app.enableWebSocket = true;
app.WsOnConnectionChanged = (_, _) =&gt; Task.CompletedTask;
</code></pre>
<p>PicoServer 开启 WebSocket 后，通过以下方法广播：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">await app.WsBroadcastAsync("reload");
</code></pre>
<h3 id="23-客户端脚本注入">2.3 客户端脚本注入</h3>
<p>在返回 HTML 时自动注入 WebSocket 客户端代码，开发者无需手动添加：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">if (filePath.EndsWith(".html", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
{
    var content = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(filePath);
    var script = """
        &lt;script&gt;
        new WebSocket('ws://'+location.host+'/ws-reload').onmessage = e =&gt; {
            if (e.data === 'reload') location.reload();
        };
        &lt;/script&gt;
        """;
    
    content = content.Contains("&lt;/body&gt;")
        ? content.Replace("&lt;/body&gt;", script + "&lt;/body&gt;")
        : content + script;
    
    await res.WriteAsync(content, "text/html");
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="24-路径放行">2.4 路径放行</h3>
<p><code>/ws-reload</code> 路径需要交给 WebSocket 处理，静态文件中间件应放行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">if (path == "/ws-reload") return true;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三完整示例">三、完整示例</h2>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using PicoServer;
using System.Timers;

var app = new WebAPIServer();
app.enableWebSocket = true;
app.WsOnConnectionChanged = (_, _) =&gt; Task.CompletedTask;

string staticRoot = "wwwroot";
var watcher = new FileSystemWatcher(staticRoot) { EnableRaisingEvents = true };
var timer = new System.Timers.Timer(200) { AutoReset = false };
timer.Elapsed += async (_, _) =&gt; await app.WsBroadcastAsync("reload");
watcher.Changed += (s, e) =&gt; { timer.Stop(); timer.Start(); };

app.AddMiddleware(async (req, res) =&gt;
{
    var path = req.Url?.AbsolutePath ?? "";
    if (path == "/ws-reload") return true;
    
    // 解析文件路径
    var reqPath = path.TrimStart('/');
    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(reqPath)) reqPath = "index.html";
    var filePath = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(staticRoot, reqPath));
    
    // 安全检查
    if (!filePath.StartsWith(staticRoot) || !File.Exists(filePath))
    {
        res.StatusCode = 404;
        await res.WriteAsync("Not Found");
        return false;
    }
    
    // HTML 文件：注入脚本后返回
    if (filePath.EndsWith(".html", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    {
        var content = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(filePath);
        var script = """
            &lt;script&gt;
            new WebSocket('ws://'+location.host+'/ws-reload').onmessage = e =&gt; {
                if (e.data === 'reload') location.reload();
            };
            &lt;/script&gt;
            """;
        content = content.Contains("&lt;/body&gt;")
            ? content.Replace("&lt;/body&gt;", script + "&lt;/body&gt;")
            : content + script;
        await res.WriteAsync(content, "text/html");
    }
    else
    {
        // 非 HTML 文件：直接返回
        await res.SendFileAsync(filePath, false);
    }
    return false;
});

app.StartServer(8080);
Console.WriteLine("热重载已启动: http://localhost:8080");
await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="四扩展方向">四、扩展方向</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>CSS 热更新</strong>：广播 <code>css</code> 消息，客户端仅刷新样式链接</li>
<li><strong>多设备同步</strong>：局域网内多端同时刷新</li>
<li><strong>差异化刷新</strong>：根据文件类型决定刷新策略（如 <code>.css</code> 增量更新，<code>.cshtml</code> 全页刷新）</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="五关于-aot">五、关于 AOT</h2>
<p>热重载工具本身也应当保持轻量。Node.js 工具链通常需要安装运行时并下载数百 MB 依赖。</p>
<p>通过 .NET AOT 编译，整个热重载服务器可打包为 <strong>4-10 MB 的单文件</strong>，无需安装 .NET 运行时，拷贝即用。</p>
<h2 id="六总结">六、总结</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>组件</th>
<th>代码量</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>

<td>15 行</td>
</tr>

<td>WebSocket 广播</td>
<td>1 行</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td>10 行</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>总计</strong></td>
<td><strong>26 行</strong></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>26 行代码，解决开发中最频繁的中断问题。</p>
